verdict.rationale: Activepieces keeps edits as a draft separate from the published flow until you click Publish, which gives a basic form of versioning. In projects marked Sensitive, publishing requires approval from a user with the PUBLISH_SENSITIVE_FLOW_ACCESS permission, which covers review. Nothing in the evidence shows a version history or a way to roll back to an earlier published version. Missing for 10: explicit version history, a documented rollback or restore of prior versions, diff/review tooling outside Sensitive projects, and independent hands-on corroboration.
